narrative: The model predicted that the product "Winco Bamboo Skewer, 6 inch" belongs to the "Arts, Crafts & Sewing" category with a confidence of 27.48%. This prediction was influenced primarily by the bag-of-words features; while the word "use" appears in the product and was among the most influential features, other important words such as "enough", "suppli", and "color" were not present, which might have diminished their direct impact. The model heavily relied on the co-purchase relationships of the target product. Key 1-hop neighbors like "Loew Cornell Woodsies Craft Sticks" and "Surebonder All Temperature Mini Glue Sticks", both categorized under "Arts, Crafts & Sewing", strongly suggested a similar category for the bamboo skewers due to their crafting utility. Additionally, 2-hop neighbors such as "BAZIC Natural Craft Sticks" and "Darice Victoria Lynn Chenille Stems", also associated with arts and crafts, further reinforced this connection, likely because these items are commonly used together in crafting activities. The shared purchasing patterns with these neighboring products created a network of associations strongly pointing toward the crafting category, leading the model to predict "Arts, Crafts & Sewing" for the skewers.
